# Sandbox: Merchant card payments

import PartnerTestingApiIntro from './partials/_partner-testing-api-intro.mdx';

<PartnerTestingApiIntro />

:::tip Prerequisites
- Merchant profile status: `Enabled`
- Online card payment method status: `Enabled`

[Simulate updating the statuses](./merchants.mdx) for your <Term id="merchant-profile">merchant profile</Term> and online card payment method if needed.
:::

## Simulate creating a payment link {#simulate-link}

Create a <Term id="payment-link">payment link</Term> in the main API section of the API Explorer, not the Testing API.

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4-6,13} showLineNumbers
mutation CardPaymentLink {
  createMerchantPaymentLink(
    input: {
      merchantProfileId: "$MERCHANT_PROFILE_ID"
      amount: { value: "50", currency: "EUR" }
      paymentMethodIds: "$CARD_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID"
      label: "Link for card payment simulation"
    }
  ) {
    ... on CreateMerchantPaymentLinkSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      merchantPaymentLink {
        id
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json {6} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "createMerchantPaymentLink": {
      "__typename": "CreateMerchantPaymentLinkSuccessPayload",
      "merchantPaymentLink": {
        "id": "$YOUR_MERCHANT_PAYMENT_LINK_ID"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Simulate receiving merchant card payment {#simulate-receive}

Enter the `id` from the `createMerchantPaymentLink` success payload.

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=test-api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4} showLineNumbers
mutation SimulateOnlineCardPaymentReception {
  simulateIncomingOnlineCardAuthorization(
    input: {
      paymentLinkId: "$PAYMENT_LINK_ID"
      authorization: { status: Authorized }
      threeDS: { status: Successful }
      cardDetails: {
        scheme: Visa
        category: Commercial
        type: Credit
        country: "FRA"
      }
    }
  ) {
    ... on InternalErrorRejection {
      __typename
    }
  }
}
```

## Simulate booking merchant card payment {#simulate-book}

Get the `transactionId` from simulating the reception of a merchant card payment from your Dashboard.

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?query=bXV0YXRpb24gU2ltdWxhdGVPbmxpbmVDYXJkQm9va2luZyB7CiAgc2ltdWxhdGVJbmNvbWluZ09ubGluZUNhcmRCb29raW5nKAogICAgaW5wdXQ6IHsgdHJhbnNhY3Rpb25JZDogIiRUUkFOU0FDVElPTl9JRCIgfQogICkgewogICAgLi4uIG9uIFNpbXVsYXRlSW5jb21pbmdPbmxpbmVDYXJkQm9va2luZ1N1Y2Nlc3NQYXlsb2FkIHsKICAgICAgX190eXBlbmFtZQogICAgfQogIH0KfQo%3D&tab=test-api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {3} showLineNumbers
mutation SimulateOnlineCardBooking {
  simulateIncomingOnlineCardBooking(
    input: { transactionId: "$TRANSACTION_ID" }
  ) {
    ... on SimulateIncomingOnlineCardBookingSuccessPayload {
      __typename
    }
  }
}
```

## Simulate releasing merchant card payment {#simulate-release}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=test-api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {3} showLineNumbers
mutation SimulateRelease {
  simulateReleaseReservedBalance(
    input: { transactionId: "$TRANSACTION_ID" }
  ) {
    ... on ForbiddenRejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
    ... on TransactionNotFoundRejection {
      __typename
      message
      transactionId
    }
    ... on ReleaseReservedBalanceSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      transactionId
    }
  }
}
```
